name: Porva (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly by a white band into a black upper hoist part and a red lower fly part, charged in the upper hoist with the municipal arms of Porva: a green shield with a white ploughshare, a wavy stripe and a bough.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
